payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvements in F1 scores over previously reported results in cue detection and scope resolution tasks, indicating substantial advancements in performance.

claims.text: Substantial improvements were reported over previously reported results by at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
State-of-the-art results were achieved on negation scope resolution for the BioScope Corpus with an increase of 3.16 F1 points and 0.3 F1 points on the SFU Review Corpus.
Previous work on cue detection and scope resolution ranged from rule-based systems to deep learning-based approaches.
